This keeps the sensors finely spaced, so the signal is smooth, while still covering the 25 mm tape across a wider lateral band. The 12 mm footprint overlaps neighbours, so the line is never lost at the centre. Weights are antisymmetric and scaled so the signal stays within +/-1. (3) Keep kp at 3.0, the middle value from the two earlier runs, rather than moving it up. (4) Raise ki from 0.02 to 0.10. The fixed left/right motor mismatch is a constant bias, and integral action can cancel it; the integral is capped at +/-2, so windup is limited. (5) Set kd to 0.8 to damp the extra proportional response from the denser sensors. (6) Set base_speed to 1.4, between the two earlier values.
